effect_description_eng:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. Then, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend in their next unsuspend phase.
[All Turns] This Digimon is also treated as Lv.6 [Breakdramon] for [Examon]'s DNA digivolution.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts delete your opponent's Digimon in battle, trash their top security card.
